notes:
- Annotation format rebuilt to the Colour Block study (50 reels of the reference creator, frame by frame): big caption text now comes in blocks, the whole meaningful phrase of a sentence, never scattered single words.
- A few highlight words a video in your special font and brand colour; colours and fonts always come from your Brand DNA.
- Annotations only cover a phrase of 4 or more spoken words, never one to three; an annotation can carry a bracket label (\"[UNPREPARED]\") with the spoken words small under it.
- Big words low in the frame stay clear of the platform's buttons.
- Two annotations never sit back to back, and an annotation's last word no longer shows on the next picture when a breath follows it.
